sentences.en: A talk which looks at population dynamics, predator prey relationships and factors (biotic and abiotic) affecting animal populations.

sentences.en: The collective term biotope is now in common usage to encompass both of these biotic and abiotic elements.

sentences.en: The biological sample taken at the test site provides an Observed Fauna from which biotic indices are also calculated.

sentences.en: Some place emphasis on biotic, others on environmental factors.

sentences.en: This tension explains why we are addressing the biotic and expressive orders.

sentences.en: So the biotic and the cultural levels are both concerned with individual and collective behaviour.

sentences.en: If things continued this way for any other biotic population, that population would be erased or completely transformed fairly quickly.

sentences.en: The character of intertidal biotic community is a result of interaction between environmental factors and interspecific competition.
